what_this_is: The external-signal baseline taken BEFORE outreach. ROADMAP 0.5's NO-GO rule counts 'fewer than 3 independent external signals' within 8 weeks of outreach landing; without a before, that count has nothing to be measured against.

repository.method: gh api repos/Sahil170595/quantfit; gh api .../stargazers; gh pr list --state all --limit 200

control_query.why: a zero is only informative if the same command returns non-zero for a query that should match

quantfit.why: Algolia prefix-matches 'quanti*', so the hits are 'quantitative' stories, not this project. Recorded as uninterpretable rather than as a signal.

pypi_downloads.reason: pypistats.org returned HTTP 429 RATE LIMIT EXCEEDED on two attempts
pypi_downloads.note: ROADMAP 0.5 already excludes raw pypistats counts as mirror/bot noise unless decomposed, so this absence does not weaken the baseline.
